source.snippet: - the hot lead badge, to be able to click on this and select other options (cold lead, customer, past customer) - add a export button that can pull the CSV data from conversations for faster KB improvements - the closed/open badge at the top, make this clickable so we don;t need to scroll on the right side everytime - to be able to add customer notes on the right side, so we can flag VIP or difficult people etc - the reserve here link takes you to the generic reserve page, not a pre filled basket

problem_statement: Small rental business operators using lightweight helpdesk tools lack CRM-grade lead lifecycle management: they cannot transition leads through stages (hot/cold/customer/past customer), annotate VIP or difficult customers, or export conversation data for knowledge-base improvement without manual workarounds.
target_segment: Small rental business owners and operators (vacation rentals, equipment rentals) using niche helpdesk/CRM hybrids
notes: Active paying user filing detailed enhancement requests on a live rental management product (Lolodesk). Multiple friction points in a single ticket suggest this is a retained, engaged customer — strong buyer signal. Features requested map directly to upsell tier: lead lifecycle + VIP tagging + data export are classic CRM add-on revenue.
